label: C4 — realnewslike
description: A news-like English web-text slice of the C4 corpus (Common Crawl derived), streamed and sampled to 5,000 documents.
highlight: Already extracted upstream (Common Crawl WET files), so almost nothing for the Extraction stage to do — 99.8% of documents pass straight through. Still real broken-UTF and control-character noise for Normalize+Clean to catch, and effectively zero ghost tokens or non-Latin script content — its own useful data point: not every dataset needs every strategy.
facts: News-like web text; Common Crawl WET-extracted upstream, so already mostly de-HTML'd
